lines.text_source: Vanij, come, we must go now. No one can know that I'm taking you with me. You're my most powerful disciple, second only to the other children.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Vanij, venha. Devemos ir agora. Ninguém pode saber que a estou levando comigo. Você é minha discípula mais poderosa, apenas superada pelos outros escolhidos.
lines.risk_notes: Identity/affiliation of speaker ambiguous in source; 'most powerful disciple' + 'other children' suggests hidden mentor/darker context not yet revealed—ensure no premature disclosure. Formal register maintained; 'Vanij' is proper noun (non-localized). Phrase 'second only to the other children' restructured for clarity (pt-BR would force ambiguity resolution); chosen 'apenas superado pelos outros escolhidos' to preserve mystery without over-explaining.

lines.text_source: We will travel to a new world, one where I will never see the light of day again. That will be my penitence.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Viajaremos para um novo mundo, onde nunca verei a luz do dia novamente. Essa será minha penitência.
lines.risk_notes: 'Never see the light of day again' is figurative (self-imprisonment/penitence); literal translation risks misinterpretation. Restructured as 'nunca verei a luz do dia novamente' (preserves formality and solemnity expected of Beigon's register). 'Penitence' = 'penitência' (formal, matches tone). New world proper noun (non-localized). Byte budget: 108 chars; transliterated form fits without overflow.
